what_was_done: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/synthesis/spec.md, dev.json and the checker code in lab/core.py. Wrote 21 tasks with a Python build script: 13 contradiction tasks (11 letter-pair, 1 disputed-detail label, 1 disputed-entity name) and 8 entity-linking chains (2 in tool mode).
how_answers_were_verified: Each contradiction task encodes every document's facts as a table (derived values such as 2058-15, 07:40 to 08:15, 6+9+5, weekday of 4 June 2041, 2 km in metres are computed in Python); a pairwise comparison asserts exactly one conflicting pair and that pair becomes the answer. The pair regex is asserted to accept both orders and common surface forms and to reject every other pair and three-letter answers. Chain tasks compute the answer by composing Python dicts (the elimination task enumerates all permutations and asserts a unique assignment). Negatives are the tempting wrong answer (decoy pair, pre-memo value, first-listed entity).
